UserSecuritySession.title: UserSecuritySession
UserSecuritySession.description: Owner-only Google-authenticated security unlock session for Live Wallet Mode (zero PII stored).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated owner.

walletModeUnlocked.description: Whether Live Wallet Mode and real-coin handoffs are currently unlocked.

WalletSetApproval.title: WalletSetApproval
WalletSetApproval.description: Non-custodial audit record created when a Google-verified user dispatches or signs a 10-Set Buy/Sell order in Trust Wallet or Xaman.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated owner.

publicWalletAddress.description: Public self-custody wallet address (never private keys).

buyPrice.description: Planned limit buy price in USD.

sellPrice.description: Planned limit sell or safety stop price in USD.

AcademyPublicGates.title: AcademyPublicGates
AcademyPublicGates.description: Publicly readable non-PII curriculum gate hashes (SHA-256 only, zero plaintext passwords) and public orientation video metadata.

intermediatePasscodeHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the normalized Intermediate cohort passcode.

advancedPasscodeHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the normalized Advanced cohort passcode.

intermediateGateEnabled.description: Whether Intermediate curriculum chapters require passcode or Admin Google login.

advancedGateEnabled.description: Whether Advanced curriculum chapters require passcode or Admin Google login.

orientationVideoUrl.description: Optional public URL or /assets path for the Progressive Mastery Orientation Video.

orientationVideoTitle.description: Public title of the Progressive Mastery Orientation Video.

AcademyAdminSettings.title: AcademyAdminSettings
AcademyAdminSettings.description: Strictly Admin-isolated settings containing optional separate Admin Google email and instructor passcode reference labels.

secondaryAdminEmail.description: Optional separate Google login email granted full Academy Admin privileges.

intermediatePasscodeLabel.description: Admin-only readable reference label for the active Intermediate passcode.

advancedPasscodeLabel.description: Admin-only readable reference label for the active Advanced passcode.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Admin who last saved these settings.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only Google-authenticated security session state per user UID.

/users/{userId}/walletApprovals/{approva.description: Owner-only non-custodial wallet sign/approval dispatches gated by parent UserSecuritySession.

/academyConfig/{configId}.description: Singleton public curriculum gate configuration (configId == 'publicGates') storing SHA-256 passcode hashes and orientation video URL.

/academyAdmin/{adminDocId}.description: Singleton Admin-isolated settings document (adminDocId == 'settings') storing separate Admin Google email and instructor passcode hints.
